pipeline.title: The 3-Pillar Pipeline Architecture
pipeline.subtitle: Three phases from first idea to publish-ready master — Series Room, Blueprint Room, and Production Stage.

ui.landscapeHint: Rotate your device for a wider landscape view
ui.howItWorksLabel: How it works in this phase

pillars.title: Series Room Generation
pillars.header: Build a Universe, Not a Clip
pillars.body: Describe your series or YouTube channel once, and SceneFlow builds the whole world — storyline, cast, and an unlimited episode slate — with a Shared Reference Library that keeps every episode on-brand.

steps.title: Start with your concept
steps.description: Drop in a concept or a detailed description of your series or YouTube channel. SceneFlow turns it into a structured, production-ready foundation — no prompt engineering required.
steps.imagePlaceholder: New series intake — concept or channel description

steps.title: Review the SceneFlow baseline
steps.description: SceneFlow returns a professional baseline scored by Audience Resonance Analysis. Read or listen to the narrated overview, then steer it with your own direction.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Series baseline — Audience Resonance score and narrated overview

steps.title: Create unlimited episodes
steps.description: Spin up as many episodes as your story needs. Each one inherits your series DNA, so the cast, tone, and world stay consistent from episode one to the season finale.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Episode slate — unlimited episodes generated from the series arc

steps.title: Review the Reference Library
steps.description: Browse the shared Reference Library — characters, voices, wardrobe, locations, and props — created and maintained through Production Stage and reused across every episode.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Shared Reference Library — characters, voices, locations, props

steps.title: Direct the Intelligent Assistant Writer
steps.description: Reshape the series or any episode by speaking or typing your direction. The Intelligent Assistant Writer rewrites professional copy instantly — no blank page, no prompt engineering.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Intelligent Assistant Writer — voice or text direction on series and episodes

steps.title: Start production in one click
steps.description: When an episode feels right, start its production with a single click and flow straight into the guided Production Stage pipeline.
steps.imagePlaceholder: One-click start production on a selected episode

pillars.title: Blueprint Room
pillars.body: Blueprint Room is your deep film treatment — synopsis, beats, characters, tone, and style — pre-scored by Audience Resonance Analysis so you approve a story that lands before a single frame renders.

steps.title: Review the baseline Blueprint
steps.description: Open a professional baseline Blueprint with Audience Resonance Analysis built in. Read or listen to the narrated overview to hear exactly why it works.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Baseline Blueprint — treatment with Audience Resonance score

steps.title: Direct the Intelligent Assistant Writer
steps.description: Refine the synopsis, beats, characters, and more by speaking or typing your direction. The Intelligent Assistant Writer revises the treatment instantly — no prompt engineering.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Intelligent Assistant Writer — editing synopsis, beats, and characters

steps.title: Review the Reasoning
steps.description: Open the Reasoning section for a creative explanation of the current Blueprint — the story logic behind every beat and character choice.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Reasoning panel — creative explanation of the Blueprint

steps.title: Start production when ready
steps.description: Once the story sings, start production — and the entire pipeline inherits your approved creative DNA with no drift.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Open Production Stage — readiness gate from an approved blueprint

pillars.title: Production Stage
pillars.body: Production Stage runs concurrent, multi-engine generation — script, audio, frames, and video — with the Intelligent Assistant Director, the Screening Room, and multilanguage streams carrying you from approved script to a published 4K master.

steps.title: Review the baseline script
steps.description: Start from a professional baseline script with Audience Resonance Analysis. Read or listen to the narrated analysis to know what lands before you spend a credit.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Baseline script — Audience Resonance analysis and narrated overview

steps.title: Optimize scene by scene
steps.description: Use the Intelligent Assistant Writer to optimize the script scene by scene — tighten dialogue, reshape beats, and apply one-click improvements by voice or text.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Intelligent Assistant Writer — scene-by-scene script optimization

steps.title: Build the Reference Library
steps.description: Create or update the Reference Library with scripted, custom, or uploaded characters, voices, wardrobes, locations, and props. Edit reference images directly — no "slot machine" regenerations.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Reference Library — characters, voices, wardrobe, locations, props

steps.title: Generate audio
steps.description: Generate dialogue, narration, SFX, and music with Run All Agents across all scenes, Audio Agent per scene, or beat by beat — native-quality voiceover in 70+ languages.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Audio Agent — all scenes, single scene, or beat by beat

steps.title: Generate and edit frames
steps.description: Generate beat frames with Run All Agents, Stills Agent per scene, or beat by beat, then edit any frame with the Intelligent Assistant Director (IAD) — just describe the change.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Beat frames with Intelligent Assistant Director edits

steps.title: Review the animatic
steps.description: Play the full animatic — frames, dialogue, SFX, and music — in the interactive Screening Room, and share a link for feedback without exporting a file.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Screening Room — interactive animatic review and sharing

steps.title: Generate video
steps.description: Turn approved frames into motion with Video Agent per scene or beat by beat. Retake any shot with the Intelligent Assistant Director — no endless slot-machine regenerations.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Video Agent generation with IAD retakes

steps.title: Edit in the Mixer
steps.description: Polish every scene in the Mixer — captions, trims, dubbing, overlays, and audio balance — brand-safe finishing without leaving the studio.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Mixer — captions, trim, dubbing, and audio controls

steps.title: Render and review scenes
steps.description: Render your scenes, then review and share them through the Screening Room to lock approval before final assembly.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Rendered scenes reviewed and shared in the Screening Room

steps.title: Generate multilanguage streams
steps.description: Spin up dubbed or lip-synced language streams from the same approved cut — reach 70+ markets without re-shooting a single frame.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Multilanguage streams — dubbed and lip-sync per locale

steps.title: Render final and publish
steps.description: Render the final production into a master and publish — auto-generated thumbnails, titles, and descriptions ready for your YouTube channel and beyond.
steps.imagePlaceholder: Final render and one-click publish to YouTube

keyFeatures.title: From the idea to the master.
keyFeatures.subtitle: Series Room → Blueprint Room → Production Stage → Screening Room.
keyFeatures.landingUiLanguagesLabel: Produce, dub, and regenerate dialogue & signage clips in 44 languages. Full Studio UI and this site are localized for our 6 core Google AI markets:

rooms.label: Series Room
rooms.headline: Build a universe once. Produce episodes forever.
rooms.promise: Develop a multi-episode season with one shared creative bible. Your cast, locations, story threads, and visual DNA carry automatically into every episode you spin up. Producing a standalone film? Skip straight to the Blueprint Room.

features.title: New Series
features.description: Pitch your series or channel concept in plain language. Interactive AI refinement sharpens your premise and generates a multi-episode season baseline—complete with overarching plot arcs and episode breakdowns.
features.screenshot: Create New Series — intent, Clarify and Confirm, Generate Series

items.title: Your intent
items.description: Pitch the premise, format, target audience, and visual art style in plain language.

items.title: Interactive refinement
items.description: Clarify and Confirm sharpens the season synopsis with you before anything is generated.

items.title: Season baseline
items.description: Generate Series builds a five-episode season arc that you can expand anytime.

features.title: Season Bible & Continuity
features.description: Read or listen to the narrated season overview and episode slate. SceneFlow locks your story threads, cast profiles, locations, and signature props into a shared Reference Library that every episode inherits.
features.screenshot: Overview Listen, Episodes Listen, Consistency, Continuity — Cast, Locations, Props, Settings

items.title: Read or listen
items.description: Audit the season overview and every episode synopsis with built-in audio narration.

items.title: Story consistency
items.description: Aesthetics, key plot events, and narrative threads stay locked across the entire season.

items.title: Shared continuity
items.description: Cast, locations, props, and settings carry automatically into every episode you produce.

features.title: Audience Resonance
features.description: Test your season arc against your target demographic before writing a single script. Review episode-by-episode resonance scores and apply data-backed story improvements with one click—only when you agree with the note.
features.screenshot: Audience Resonance analysis, then Actionable Insights, unapplied

items.title: Demographic scoring
items.description: Scores and structural analysis reveal how your season lands with your target audience.

items.title: Director's prerogative
items.description: Actionable Insights update your series only when you choose to apply them.

features.title: The Series Director
features.description: Reshape the entire season by voice or text. Shift the tone, raise the stakes, or rework a character arc across all episodes at once while keeping the rest of your storyline intact.
features.screenshot: Series Director — direction, focus, accept

items.title: Plain-language direction
items.description: Speak or type your note and target plot, characters, episode arcs, tone, or setting.

items.title: Surgical updates
items.description: Nothing changes until you accept the revision, and unrelated story threads stay untouched.

items.title: Guided recommendations
items.description: Apply AI-suggested story improvements or steer every creative choice yourself.

features.title: Episode-Level Direction
features.description: Zoom into any individual episode to rework its plot, pacing, or hook in isolation—without destabilizing the rest of your season slate.
features.screenshot: Episodes — Direct this episode, other episodes unchanged

items.title: Isolated rewrites
items.description: Direct changes to a single episode's outline and beats without altering neighboring episodes.

items.title: Season integrity
items.description: The overarching season bible and remaining episode slate stay locked.

features.title: One-Click Episode Launch
features.description: When an episode's outline hits the mark, launch it straight into the Blueprint Room with its synopsis, story beats, cast, and world already wired in.
features.screenshot: Start Project — outline and cast already on the episode

items.title: Instant handoff
items.description: Launch any episode directly into the Blueprint Room with a single click.

items.title: Pre-wired DNA
items.description: The episode outline, synopsis, story beats, cast, and locations travel automatically.

rooms.label: Blueprint Room
rooms.headline: Lock the story and the look before a single frame renders.
rooms.promise: Whether you are launching an episode from the Series Room or starting a standalone feature, the Blueprint Room is where your creative DNA locks in. Perfect the beat sheet, cast, locations, and visual style here—so the Production Stage builds the right script on the first pass.

features.title: Start the Blueprint
features.description: Bring in an episode from your series slate with its outline and cast pre-loaded, or pitch a brand-new film concept from scratch and let AI structure the foundational treatment.
features.screenshot: Series episode already known, or Start Your Project — intent, Validate & Enhance with AI, Generate Blueprint

items.title: From Series Room
items.description: Series episodes arrive with their outline, synopsis, beats, and cast already attached.

items.title: Standalone project
items.description: Pitch a new film concept, refine it with AI validation, and generate a complete treatment.

features.title: The Beat Sheet
features.description: Structure the spine of your film. Read or listen to your narrative beat sheet and fine-tune the pacing here—every beat you lock in the Blueprint Room drives a chapter in the Production Stage.
features.screenshot: Beats tab, with Listen

items.title: Narrative spine
items.description: Beats are authored and locked in the Blueprint Room before script generation begins.

items.title: Pacing first
items.description: Optimizing the beat sheet here ensures the screenplay builds with tight dramatic structure.

items.title: Beat-to-chapter mapping
items.description: Production Stage turns each beat into a chapter.

features.title: Cast & World Design
features.description: Define your characters, wardrobe, and primary locations before the screenplay is generated—ensuring the script is written around your exact cast and settings from page one.
features.screenshot: Characters tab, then Setting on Story

items.title: Character profiles
items.description: Direct your cast profiles up front so dialogue and blocking match each character.

items.title: World & locations
items.description: Establish primary settings on the Story tab to anchor every scene's environment.

items.title: Zero script refactoring
items.description: Locking cast and locations before script generation eliminates costly rewrites on the Production Stage.

features.title: The Blueprint Director
features.description: Speak or type your story notes to revise beats, characters, or world details. Preview a balanced revision side-by-side—nothing changes in your treatment until you approve the cut.
features.screenshot: Blueprint Director — direction, focus, preview, Apply revision

items.title: Targeted notes
items.description: Speak or type your direction and focus the revision on Beats, Characters, or Story.

items.title: Side-by-side preview
items.description: Review a balanced revision before committing any changes to your Blueprint.

items.title: You hold the lock
items.description: Nothing in your treatment changes until you explicitly apply the revision.

features.title: Audience Resonance
features.description: Score your treatment against your target audience's cultural and demographic profile. Catch structural pacing gaps early and apply targeted recommendations in the Blueprint Director.
features.screenshot: Audience Resonance — saved audience, scores, recommendations unapplied

items.title: Pre-script validation
items.description: Analyze your treatment against your target audience to see category scores and story notes.

items.title: Selective application
items.description: Recommendations only modify your Blueprint when you choose to apply them.

features.title: Greenlight to Production
features.description: When the treatment, beat sheet, and cast are locked, step onto the Production Stage. SceneFlow compiles your full multi-chapter script directly from your approved Blueprint.
features.screenshot: Go to Production Stage — storyline, beats, and cast already set

items.title: Seamless compilation
items.description: Stepping onto the Production Stage compiles the full script directly from your approved Blueprint.

items.title: Locked foundation
items.description: Your storyline, beat structure, and cast arrive ready for scene and shot direction.

rooms.label: Production Stage
rooms.headline: From script to master, all in one room.
rooms.promise: The Blueprint is locked. Your cast is cast. Now, step onto the Production Stage. Every chapter, scene, and shot is organized into a linear workflow. You direct the intent; intelligent agents execute the generation.

groups.label: Direct & Control
groups.headline: Speak the language of film, not the syntax of prompts.
groups.description: Don't waste time typing bracketed keywords. The Production Stage understands natural direction, applying your vision across the entire scene or down to the specific shot.

features.title: The Scene & Shot Director
features.description: Type or speak your direction in plain language. Tell the agent who is in the frame, where the camera moves, and what the emotional beat is. The Shot Director automatically writes the complex underlying prompts for your stills and clips.
features.screenshot: The Scene & Shot Director — plain-language direction for stills and clips

items.title: Plain language
items.description: Type or speak who is in the frame, where the camera moves, and what the emotional beat is.

items.title: Scene or shot
items.description: Apply your vision across the entire scene or down to the specific shot.

items.title: Prompt compilation
items.description: The Shot Director automatically writes the underlying prompts for your stills and clips.

features.title: The Continuity Library
features.description: Absolute consistency across the series. Automatically generate or manually assign reference images for your cast, wardrobes, locations, and essential props to ensure every shot matches the Blueprint.
features.screenshot: The Continuity Library — cast, wardrobes, locations, and essential props

items.title: Series consistency
items.description: Keep cast, wardrobes, locations, and essential props unified across every shot.

items.title: Generate or assign
items.description: Automatically generate reference images or manually assign your own to match the Blueprint.

features.title: Audience Resonance Integration
features.description: Get a read on the room before you render. AI analyzes your script against your target audience, providing scene-by-scene insights. Apply recommended directions instantly, or trust your gut and ignore them.
features.screenshot: Audience Resonance Integration — scene-by-scene audience insights

items.title: Scene-by-scene insights
items.description: AI analyzes your script against your target audience before you render.

items.title: Your call
items.description: Apply recommended directions instantly, or trust your gut and ignore them.

features.title: Production Planner
features.description: Establish the budget and schedule generation across every scene and chapter using SceneFlow credits or your own BYOK API keys. Set still and clip targets per shot before you spend compute.
features.screenshot: Production Planner — budget, schedule, and BYOK API keys

items.title: Budget and schedule
items.description: Establish the budget and schedule generation across every scene and chapter before you render.

items.title: Credits or BYOK
items.description: Run generation using SceneFlow credits or your own BYOK API keys.

features.title: Production Script
features.description: Built for traditional and AI filmmakers alike. Preview a clean, formatted screenplay in-studio and export in industry-standard formats (PDF, FDX, Fountain). Use SceneFlow as a standalone script room—or pair your screenplay with a Pre-Vis Animatic and Promo Trailer to pitch financiers and secure project funding.
features.screenshot: Production Script — in-platform preview and PDF, FDX, and Fountain export

items.title: In-platform preview & export
items.description: Preview the formatted script in the studio and export in industry-standard PDF, Final Draft FDX, or Fountain format.

items.title: For traditional filmmakers
items.description: Use SceneFlow as an intelligent script production platform without generating video.

items.title: Pitch & project funding
items.description: Package your script with a Pre-Vis Animatic and Promo Trailers to pitch and acquire project funding.

groups.label: Generate & Audit
groups.headline: Prove the cut before you spend the compute.
groups.description: Don't guess how a scene will play. SceneFlow separates audio and still generation from expensive motion rendering, letting you audit the rhythm of the edit first.

features.title: The Audio Agent
features.description: Generate dialogue, sound effects, and music scores concurrently across up to 30 shots per scene. Cast voices automatically match character profiles or can be custom-tuned.
features.screenshot: The Audio Agent — concurrent dialogue, sound effects, and music scores

items.title: Concurrent audio
items.description: Generate dialogue, sound effects, and music scores concurrently across up to 30 shots per scene.

items.title: Character voices
items.description: Cast voices automatically match character profiles or can be custom-tuned.

features.title: The Stills Agent
features.description: Rapidly generate the keyframe images that illustrate your shot direction. Regenerate, edit, or upload your own references to lock the composition.
features.screenshot: The Stills Agent — keyframe composition and references

items.title: Keyframe generation
items.description: Rapidly generate the keyframe images that illustrate your shot direction.

items.title: Lock the composition
items.description: Regenerate, edit, or upload your own references before committing to motion.

features.title: The Pre-Vis Animatic
features.description: Watch the scene breathe. Review a fully assembled animatic—stitched stills, Ken Burns motion, and locked audio—in the Screening Room. Audit the pacing, share for feedback, and ensure the cut works before committing to video.
features.screenshot: The Pre-Vis Animatic — stitched stills, Ken Burns motion, and locked audio

items.title: Assembled animatic
items.description: Review stitched stills, Ken Burns motion, and locked audio in the Screening Room.

items.title: Audit and share
items.description: Audit the pacing, share for feedback, and ensure the cut works before committing to video.

features.title: The Clips Agent
features.description: Once the Pre-Vis is approved, the Clips Agent takes over, rendering high-fidelity motion clips that adhere strictly to your approved stills and continuity references.
features.screenshot: The Clips Agent — high-fidelity motion clips from approved stills

items.title: After Pre-Vis approval
items.description: The Clips Agent renders motion only after the Pre-Vis animatic is approved.

items.title: Strict adherence
items.description: High-fidelity motion clips adhere strictly to your approved stills and continuity references.

groups.label: Publish & Distribute
groups.headline: Ship the master, or localize for the world.
groups.description: When the scene is done, the assets are already unified. Finish the edit, localize audio plus in-scene dialogue and signage clips, and distribute directly to your audience.

features.title: The Mixer
features.description: A built-in, intuitive scene editor. Trim clips, adjust speed ramps, add text overlays, and apply watermarks without leaving the studio.
features.screenshot: The Mixer — trim clips, speed ramps, text overlays, and watermarks

items.title: Built-in scene editor
items.description: Trim clips and adjust speed ramps directly inside the studio.

items.title: Finishing touches
items.description: Add text overlays and apply watermarks without exporting to an external editor.

features.title: Streams (Multi-Language)
features.description: Expand your global reach across 44 languages from one master timeline. Automatically generate alternate language streams with dubbed audio, lip-sync, and regenerated multi-language dialogue and in-scene signage clips—while directing in a localized Studio UI.
features.screenshot: Streams (Multi-Language) — dubbed audio, regenerated dialogue and signage clips

items.title: Dubbed audio & lip-sync
items.description: Automatically generate alternate language streams across 44 languages with expressive dubbed audio and synced lip movement.

items.title: Regenerated dialogue & signage clips
items.description: Regenerate localized dialogue takes and in-scene signage clips directly within the scene so visuals and speech match every audience.

items.title: Localized Studio UI
items.description: Direct and produce in your native interface across English, Spanish, Portuguese, Hindi, Simplified Chinese, and Arabic.

features.title: Promo & Trailers

features.screenshot: Promo & Trailers — multi-language horizontal and vertical trailers

items.title: Social-ready trailers

items.title: Multi-language formats
items.description: Generate multi-language versions optimized for horizontal or vertical formats.

features.title: Direct Publishing
features.description: Export the final master MP4, or let SceneFlow auto-generate thumbnails and descriptions to publish scenes, chapters, and promos directly to YouTube, TikTok, and Facebook.
features.screenshot: Direct Publishing — MP4 export and direct publishing to YouTube, TikTok, and Facebook

items.title: Master MP4 or direct social
items.description: Export the final master MP4 or publish scenes, chapters, and promos directly to YouTube, TikTok, and Facebook.

items.title: Auto-generated metadata

rooms.label: Screening Room
rooms.headline: Screen the cut, rally your team, and premiere globally.
rooms.promise: Your private theatre and finishing suite. Watch the Pre-Vis animatic, individual scenes, chapters, promos, and multi-language streams in one unified player. Share a single link for timestamped stakeholder notes—and ship a 3–5 minute scene, an 8–12 minute chapter, a promo, or the master while the rest of the production continues.

features.title: One Unified Player
features.description: Toggle seamlessly between Pre-Vis animatics, scenes, chapters, trailers, and your final master. Switch Language Streams on the fly to audition dubbed audio and regenerated dialogue or signage clips—always locked to the exact cut from the Mixer.
features.screenshot: Screening Room player

items.title: Every milestone in one view
items.description: Switch effortlessly among Pre-Vis, scenes, chapters, promos, and the final master.

items.title: Live language switching
items.description: Audition any Language Stream—dubbed audio, lip-sync, or regenerated dialogue and signage clips—on the fly.

items.title: Frame-locked to the Mixer
items.description: Every stream plays the exact edit and timing rendered in the Mixer.

features.title: Frame-Accurate Collaboration
features.description: Stop exporting rough cuts to email. Share a private screening link where collaborators and investors watch in real time and drop notes directly on the picture—with instant notifications sent straight to your phone.
features.screenshot: Shared review

items.title: Private screening links
items.description: Reviewers watch full-resolution playback and leave timestamped notes on the picture.

items.title: No rough-cut file exports
items.description: Collect stakeholder feedback in one place without mailing heavy video files.

items.title: Instant mobile alerts
items.description: New reviewer notes notify you immediately on your phone while you direct on desktop.
